head: c9cf673319486b6c8150b0b8b54e0e2761a95aed
headline: Gift wrapping is now optional at checkout, recorded with each order, and adds a $3 fee before tax.
what_changed: Customers or checkout integrations can select gift wrapping during checkout.
A selected wrap adds $3 to the amount before the existing 20% tax, so its effect on the final total is $3.60.
Staff can see whether an order requested gift wrapping in the saved order record.
The change was tested both for pricing and with a checkout request.

risks.title: Text value may enable wrapping
risks.explanation: The checkout accepts any non-empty value as a request for gift wrapping. An integration that sends the text "false" instead of a real yes/no value would still charge for wrapping. This is unlikely with a properly built checkout, but the developer should accept only an explicit true value.

questions_for_developer: Should gift wrapping be taxed? The current change taxes it, making the final customer charge $3.60 rather than exactly $3.00.
good_news: The change is small and contained.
Orders retain the gift-wrap choice, which supports fulfilment.
Existing pricing behaviour remains covered by tests.
